died.name: Gaspard II de Coligny
died.cause: in response to one of his assassins asking, "Art thou Coligny?"
died.last_words: I am he; respect my gray hairs, young man!

died.name: John Owen
died.desc: English Nonconformist church leader and theologian
died.cause: when his secretary had written "I am still in the land of the living" in a letter in his name
died.last_words: Stop. Change that to say, 'I am yet in the land of the dying, but I hope soon to be in the land of the living.'

died.name: Ronald Knox
died.desc: English Roman Catholic priest and writer
died.cause: when Lady Elton asked if he would like her to read from his translation of the New Testament
died.last_words: No.... Awfully jolly of you to suggest it, though.

born.name: Selina Hastings, Countess of Huntingdon
born.last_words: My work is done; I have nothing to do but to go to my Father.

born.name: Thomas Picton
born.desc: Welsh officer of the British Army
born.cause: before being shot in the temple at the Battle of Waterloo

born.name: William Wilberforce
born.last_words: Thank God that I have lived to see the day when England is willing to give twenty millions for the abolition of slavery.

born.name: Theodore Parker
born.desc: American transcendentalist, Unitarian minister and abolitionist
born.cause: referring to notables who would attend his funeral
born.last_words: It is all one, Phillips and Clarke will come for my sake.

born.name: Max Beerbohm
born.cause: on being asked by his wife if he had had a good sleep

born.name: Christine Chubbuck
born.cause: The 29-year-old American news anchor from Hudson, Ohio, shot herself in the head on live television at the start of Suncoast Digest, a local newscast for WXLT-TV in Sarasota, Florida, after reading some of the area's breaking news headlines. Chubbuck was the first person to take their own life on live television.

born.name: Marc Aaronson
born.cause: The 36-year-old astronomer was crushed to death by a hatch and a revolving telescope dome at Kitt Peak National Observatory.
